# SpaceLean AI — Construction Scheduling & Project Controls Platform

> SpaceLean is an AI-native construction scheduling and project controls platform designed for General Contractors, Project Owners, and Construction Consultants. It transforms 3D BIM models (IFC/Revit) into 4D buildable sequences, predicts critical path delays with 94% accuracy, and automates subcontractor trade coordination.

## Core Capabilities

- **BIM-to-4D Sequencing**: Parses IFC and Revit models to automatically map spatial relationships, structural dependencies, and generate 4D construction timelines in under 60 seconds.
- **Predictive Risk Analysis**: Runs 1,000 probabilistic schedule simulations based on historical trade velocity, zone congestion, and weather patterns to flag critical path risks before ground-breaking.
- **Self-Healing Schedules**: Automatically re-optimizes downstream task dependencies and float when a trade slip or delivery delay occurs, eliminating manual CPM replanning.
- **Subcontractor Trade Coordination**: Generates automated 2-week lookaheads, daily site activity logs, and trade-stacking alerts to prevent site congestion.
- **Enterprise Integrations**: Imports and exports Primavera P6 XML, Microsoft Project, and Revit IFC files natively.

## Target Audiences & Use Cases

- **General Contractors (GCs)**: Eliminate trade-stacking conflicts, accelerate bid-level 4D schedule creation, and keep field crews aligned on critical path priorities.
- **Project Owners & Developers**: Gain real-time project intelligence, verify contractor milestone progress, and protect project ROI against cost overruns.
- **Construction Consultants & VDC Managers**: Offer clients 4D BIM sequence options and probabilistic delay analysis without weeks of manual Primavera P6 setup.
- **Industrial, Infrastructure & Commercial Projects**: Tailored scheduling logic for high-rise commercial structures, energy plants, highways, and civil infrastructure.

## Pricing Tiers

- **Free Tier**: $0/month — Includes 1 active project, basic AI task generator, 4D BIM viewer (up to 50MB IFC), and community support.
- **Pro Tier**: $19/user/month (billed annually) — Includes unlimited projects, full 4D BIM sequencing, 1,000-simulation predictive risk engine, Primavera P6 XML export, and priority support.
- **Enterprise Tier**: Custom pricing — Unlimited projects & storage, dedicated VDC onboarding, custom API/BIM integrations, single sign-on (SSO), and custom SLA guarantees.
